payload.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
payload.description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfil their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for an Infrastructure & Security Operations Engineer on behalf of our client to strengthen cyber defense, reduce organizational risk, and drive core security improvements across cloud, identity, endpoint, and server environments.

In this role, you will play a central part in vulnerability remediation, incident response, security monitoring, and infrastructure hardening. You will collaborate closely with infrastructure, cloud, service delivery, and third-party vendors to turn security priorities and audit findings into verified, production-ready fixes.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Security Operations (SecOps), Infrastructure Security, or Systems Administration.

  • Strong working knowledge of hybrid enterprise environments (Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, M365, Azure, or AWS).

  • Demonstrated experience with vulnerability scanning/management tools and patch coordination across multiple platforms.

  • Practical experience working with SIEM, EDR/XDR, or managed SOC/MDR escalation workflows.

  • Proven ability to coordinate technical remediation across internal teams and third-party managed service providers.

  • Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to documentation and tracking.

  • Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice-to-Have Skills:

 

  • Hands-on experience with tools like Microsoft Defender XDR, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7.

  • Experience with scripting and automation (PowerShell, KQL, Bash, or Python).

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, CIS Benchmarks, or PCI DSS.

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent).

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, and MDR/MSSP partners; support containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.

  • Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across infrastructure, cloud, and endpoint estates in coordination with system owners and external vendors.

  • Implement baseline configurations and hardening standards across hybrid environments (Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure/AWS, Active Directory, networks, and remote access).

  • Assist with privileged access management (PAM), MFA enforcement, Conditional Access, and periodic access reviews.

  • Refine detection coverage, operational playbooks, and security procedures; maintain remediation records and assist with compliance audit evidence collection.

  • Deliver concise status updates on vulnerability posture, open risks, SLAs, and technical blockers to key stakeholders.

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

 

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

 

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

 

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

 

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

 

Compensation

payload.title: Senior AI Engineer (Backend-Focused)
payload.description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join one of our high-growth client teams to lead the development of next-generation autonomous systems. This is a backend-heavy fullstack role where you will be responsible for more than just simple prompt engineering. You will be architecting Agentic Workflows—systems that can reason, use tools, and execute complex coding tasks autonomously.

 

The ideal candidate is a language-agnostic engineer who is obsessed with the Claude ecosystem and has hands-on experience building systems where AI agents interact with real-world data and codebases. You will bridge the gap between advanced LLM capabilities and robust, scalable backend production environments.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • Deep expertise in Agentic Development. You should be comfortable building multi-agent systems, ReAct loops, and self-correcting workflows.
  • Mastery of the Claude 3/3.5 family. You understand how to leverage Claude’s high reasoning capabilities and long context windows for complex logic.
  • Experience building "AI-coding" features—using LLMs to generate, refactor, and test code programmatically within an application.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major backend language (Python, C#, or JavaScript/Node.js) and the ability to design the infrastructure (APIs, Webhooks, Databases) that supports AI agents.
  • While backend-heavy, you are comfortable building the necessary frontend components (React/Vue) to allow users to interact with AI agents seamlessly.
  • Extensive experience giving LLMs "tools"—designing clean API interfaces that agents can call to perform actions in the physical or digital world.
  • Intermediate-advanced English level.
  • Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice-to-Have:

 

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.
  • Knowledge of Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate) and advanced RAG patterns.
  • Familiarity with LLM Observability tools (LangSmith, Helicone) to debug agentic reasoning chains.
  • Background in Software Engineering Fundamentals: You treat AI code like production code (CI/CD, Unit Testing, Version Control).

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and deploy autonomous agents that can handle end-to-end tasks, specifically focusing on Claude-based coding agents.
  • Build the scalable "brains" of the application, ensuring that AI reasoning is integrated into the core business logic.
  • Refine system prompts and multi-shot examples to maximize Claude’s reasoning performance.
  • Implement guardrails and validation layers to ensure that agentic outputs are safe, predictable, and high-quality.
  • Work with Product and UX teams to define how "AI Agents" should feel and behave within the product interface.

 

What we offer:

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.
